card_need: {name}, {age}, {position}: the weakest slot in the eleven is his. Rated {lo}–{hi}, potential {plo}–{phi}. £{fee}m and £{wage}k a week; £{after}m left after.
card_request: {name}, {age}, {position}: the profile you asked for. Rated {lo}–{hi}, potential {plo}–{phi}. £{fee}m and £{wage}k a week; £{after}m left after.
card_bargain: {name}, {age}, {position}: a bargain at £{fee}m, rated {lo}–{hi}, potential {plo}–{phi}. £{wage}k a week; £{after}m left after.
sale_bid: {club} have bid £{fee}m for {name} ({position}, {age}, rated {rating}). His value is about £{value}m.{unsettled}
sale_wages: The wage bill is £{bill}m against a budget of £{budget}m. {name} ({position}, {age}, £{wage}k a week) is the one to move; a buyer would pay about £{fee}m.
sale_unsettled: {name} ({position}, {age}) is unsettled and the director would move him on for about £{fee}m before it spreads.
bid_made: The bid for {name} is in: £{fee}m to {club}. The answer comes next week.
bid_signed: {name} has signed: £{fee}m from {club}, £{wage}k a week for {years} years. The director says {lo}–{hi}; the first five matches will say the rest.
bid_free: {name} has signed on a free, £{wage}k a week for {years} years. The director says {lo}–{hi}; the first five matches will say the rest.
bid_club_refused: {club} turned the bid for {name} down. The director will look elsewhere.
bid_player_refused: {name} would not come. The director will look elsewhere.
sold: {name} has gone to {club} for £{fee}m. The pot is £{pot}m.
sale_refused_unsettled: You kept {name}. He wanted the move and the room knows it.
window_open_summer: The summer window is open until week {deadline}. The director will bring names each week; the pot is £{pot}m and the wage budget £{wages}m.
window_open_january: The January window is open for the month. The pot is £{pot}m; the director will bring names each week.
deadline_quiet: Deadline day. Nothing moved: {signings} in, {sales} out.
deadline_busy: Deadline day. The window shuts with {signings} in and {sales} out, £{spend}m spent, £{pot}m left in the pot.
reveal_hit: {name} is better than the director said: rated {truth} against his {estimate}. The board are pleased with the signing.
reveal_flop: {name} is not what the director said: rated {truth} against his {estimate}. The board are asking about your signings.
reveal_even: Five matches in, {name} is about what the director said: {truth}.
sold_shines: {name}, who you sold to {club}, is playing the season of his life there. It is noticed.
another: Understood. The director will bring a different profile next week.
no_room: The squad is full: the director cannot bring anyone in until someone leaves.
no_money: The pot is empty: the director has nothing to spend. Anything more is a request to the board.
follow_card: {name} ({position}, {age}, rated {rating}) wants to come with you from {club}. They ask £{fee}m; he asks £{wage}k a week{loyal}. He would come in the next window.
follow_free: {name} ({position}, {age}, rated {rating}) is a free agent and wants to come with you. £{wage}k a week{loyal}. He would come in the next window.
follow_moved: {name} has followed you: £{fee}m to {club}, £{wage}k a week. The press have noticed.
card_free_now: {name}, {position}, {age}: a free agent, no fee, £{wage}k a week. He can sign this week; I read him at {lo}–{hi}, potential {plo}–{phi}.
card_agreed: {name}, {position}, {age}: I read him at {lo}–{hi}, potential {plo}–{phi}. £{fee}m and £{wage}k a week. The window is shut: agree it in principle and the bid goes in the day it opens, £{after}m left after.
assessment: {director}, your director of football: cover needed at {needs}. I would sell {sell}. {when}.
assessment_no_sales: {director}, your director of football: cover needed at {needs}. Nobody I would sell. {when}.
target_agreed: Agreed in principle: {name} from {club} for £{fee}m, the bid to go in when the window opens.
target_confirmed: The window is open: the bid for {name} ({club}, £{fee}m) goes in.
target_lapsed: {name} has moved on; the agreement in principle lapses.
target_lapsed_money: The pot no longer covers {name}; the agreement in principle lapses.
target_cancelled: You called off the move for {name}.
